name: hermes-server-migration
title_zh: 搬家后连记忆里的路径都改好的 Hermes 迁移工
tagline_zh: 换服务器最怕丢 cron、断会话、记忆错乱。它连 state.db 损坏都能用备份 API 救回。
tagline_en: Worried about losing cron jobs, sessions, or memory on server move? It recovers corrupted state.db, rewrites.
desc_en: Migrate a Hermes Agent instance between servers with zero loss of memory, cron jobs, or sessions. Covers state.db corruption recovery (sqlite backup API), path-rewrite sweeps across files AND database contents, venv rebuild, systemd --user adaptation, cron-DB restoration, drift_skip pinning, and Telegram reconnect verification. Triggers: "hermes migration", "move hermes to a new server", "database
why_zh: 不止搬文件，而是把 Hermes 的“记忆”也搬过去——路径重写深入数据库内容，cron 从备份恢复。
why_en: It doesn't just copy files—it migrates Hermes' memory. Path rewrites reach into DB contents, cron restores from backup.
limit_zh: 只认 Hermes Agent 实例，且源机需能运行 sqlite3 备份 API；不处理非 Hermes 服务。
limit_en: Hermes-only; source needs sqlite3 backup API. No Docker/system packages; Telegram reconnect requires manual token.
title_en: Hermes migration that rewrites paths inside memory too
